title: Spelling of his name and the Marrero surname
summary: He spells his name, gives his middle name Henry, and hesitates over how his father got the Marrero name.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: Hold on. Yeah, one second. I wanted to ask Lawrence, how do you spell your name? I've seen people spell it L-A-U. I think that's a French or Italian way of spelling Lawrence. How is it spelled for sure?
Bill, my name is spelled L-A-W-R-E-N-C-E.
Yeah, and the last name is-
Yes, the two R's together. Lawrence Marrero. Three R's all together.
But now, Bill, I have a middle name.
What's the middle name? I don't use that middle name. It's Henry. Henry. It's H. Lawrence H. Marrero. Yeah, but I very seldom use that middle name.

Yeah. Now to get back, oh, another question. This town over here, Marrero, was that named- Do you know if your folks might have come way back from- I think that was named after the sheriff of some- Well, Bill, that's something- You know anything about way back?
Yeah, something I've heard, Bill, but I wouldn't say anything about that name to my father, you know?
because it may cause something, but I heard how my daddy got that name
